messages:
maria.partnerships: Quick sync — storefront onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure (trial SKU + private offer). Need to lock publisher IDs, EULA localization, and packaging before we hit partner preview. Who can confirm the sandbox publisher IDs? Also need branding assets (hero image + 2 logos) by Wed EOD.

sam.legal: @maria.partnerships we can use RBW-AWS-PUB-2026 for AWS private offers. GCP should be redwood-pub-2026. Azure publisher ID will be provided after tenant activation. I'll start localization for EN/DE/FR T&Cs today. Uploading draft in a sec: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/terms-draft

kevin.product: For SKUs, proposing 2 initial SKUs: `redwood-inference-standard` (includes 14-day trial, metered per-10k tokens) and `redwood-inference-enterprise` (flat monthly + usage overage). Need agreement on metering units and example invoice lines. Keeping product slug short helps partner catalog search.

maria.partnerships: Sounds good. For trial UX we want a 1-click quickstart in listing + a short demo GIF. Can marketing provide hero copy? Also we need to decide whether trial requires credit card. Prefer no-cc for friction.

alex.ops: For GCP marketplace, I created a service account: `redwood-marketplace-bundle@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Reminder: set OAuth redirect and the publisher contact email to infra@redwood.com. Terraform snippet for packaging (FYI):

```
resource "google_cloud_marketplace_listing" "redwood" {
  publisher_id = "redwood-pub-2026"
  offer_id     = "redwood-inference-offer"
  sku          = "redwood-inference-standard"
}
```

alex.ops: For AWS sandbox, I'll upload assets to the partner sandbox later tonight and run the private-offer flow. Will post any schema/manifest diffs.

sam.legal: One legal flag — AWS requires we surface data residency options if customers pick EU-only processing. We should add a boolean in listing metadata: `eu_data_only: true|false`. Also need a short privacy blurb in the listing description.

kevin.product: Good call. I'll add a bullet in product description about data residency and link to our compliance page. Also drafting example invoice lines now, will share in 3h.

maria.partnerships: Action items: 1) @sam.legal — finalize EN/DE/FR T&C + privacy blurbs (due Tue 12:00 UTC). 2) @kevin.product — confirm metering model & provide invoice examples + listing copy (due Mon EOD). 3) @alex.ops — complete AWS sandbox private-offer test and GCP manifest upload (due Mon midnight). 4) Marketing — hero image + 30s demo GIF (due Wed EOD). I'll own Azure publisher activation.

deploy-bot: marketplace-assets:upload job queued (job id: ma-20260617-88). ETA: 2024-06-17T18:00Z.

kevin.product: I'll also add a 2-min quickstart doc for the listing (steps + curl examples). Suggest example token pricing line: `0.0004 USD per token unit (per 10k tokens = 4 USD)` to make pricing clear.

maria.partnerships: Agree on the quickstart. No-CC trial if legal is OK. Can we follow up Thursday 10:00am PT in #partnerships for sign-off? If someone can't make, drop updates here. :thumbsup:

sam.legal: No-CC trial looks fine with standard fraud controls. I'll add a clause for abuse/limits. Uploading T&C v1 now. :white_check_mark:

alex.ops: Running AWS sandbox tests tonight, will paste results here. If I hit manifest schema error, pinging @maria.partnerships.

maria.partnerships: Thanks all — I'll track these in the onboarding checklist and close out when each item is done.
